key_points: Competitive pressure requires accelerated timeline as industry benchmarks show leaders achieving similar transformations in shorter periods
Proposed 18-month transformation program targeting 22% efficiency gains across 14 facilities in 8 countries
Critical dependencies include securing executive sponsorship, allocating cross-functional teams, and technology infrastructure upgrades
Phase 3 (months 13-18) embeds sustainability through training programs and establishes centers of excellence
